_comment: Edit these to match your character / setup. Percent values are fractions (0.036 = 3.6%).
_esi_comment: Client ID of your app from developers.eveonline.com. When set and you've run login.bat, your real skills, standings and BPOs replace the skills/sales_tax/broker_fee/bpo_me values below.
_market_comment: Domain region / Amarr VIII (Oris) - Emperor Family Academy
_industry_comment: System where you run invention + manufacturing (used for the job cost index)
_bp_containers_comment: Optional - Blueprints tab: your blueprint container names per role, e.g. "bp_containers": {"build": "1 BUILD NOW", "invent": "2 INVENT", "bpc_missiles": "3 BPC MISSILES", "bpc_other": "4 BPC OTHER", "bpo_ammo": "5 BPO AMMO", "bpo_modules": "6 BPO GEAR", "bpo_misc": "7 BPO PARTS", "dead": "9 DEAD"}. Without it, containers named starting with those numbers are used.
_reaction_system_comment: Reactions tab: the low/null-sec system of the refinery you would react in (its cost index is used). Empty = a typical (median) reaction index.
_reaction_rig_comment: Refinery in reaction_system: material bonus from its reactor rigs (0.02 = -2%, see the Industry window facility info) and its reaction tax (owner-set).
_use_buy_orders_comment: Restock tab: true = also plan buy orders (price one step above the best bid, broker fee, fill time). false = everything you need is bought at sell orders.
_use_lp_stores_comment: Faction tab: false = blueprint copies only from contracts (bought with ISK). true = also LP store offers, with LP valued at lp_isk_value - only useful if you collect LP.
_lp_isk_value_comment: What one LP is worth to you in ISK - used to cost blueprint copies from LP stores (Faction tab). The ISK/LP column shows what you actually get per LP.
_categories_comment: Tabs in the report, each with T1 (built from NPC-sold BPOs) and T2 (invented) items: missiles, laser_crystals, mining_crystals, components (capital / advanced capital / T2 construction / T3 / structure components), mining (compressors, industrial cores, mining lasers, strip miners, harvesters, upgrades, survey gear), drones, ships, rigs (T1 rigs from salvage + invented T2 rigs), mineral_builds (other T1 items needing only minerals). modules (T1+T2 modules), other_ammo (hybrid/projectile ammo + other charges, T1+T2), deployables (mobile depots, tractor units, cyno beacons, warp disruptors ...), structures (Upwell structures, skyhooks, sov hub + upgrades). Also available: fuel (fuel blocks)

skills._comment: science = level of each of the 2 science skills required by the blueprint, encryption = racial encryption methods. Override per skill name below if they differ.

_bpo_comment: For items built from your own BPO (capital components): researched ME level and how many runs one job/batch is
_decryptor_comment: 'none', 'best' (pick highest profit per invention attempt per item) or a decryptor name like 'Accelerant Decryptor'
_material_price_comment: 'sell' = you buy instantly from sell orders, 'buy' = you place buy orders (cheaper, slower)
_product_price_comment: 'sell' = you list sell orders (pays broker fee), 'buy' = you dump into buy orders instantly
_hub_fee_discount_comment: Temporary sales tax + broker fee discount at one station. Fractured Skies (2026-11-10): Amarr VIII EFA -50% for six months. Verify in-game; remove or change when it ends.
_fees_comment: Sales tax: 7.5% base, -11% per Accounting level (IV=4.2%, V=3.375%). Broker fee in NPC station: 3% - 0.3%/Broker Relations level - standings bonus.
_structure_comment: NPC station defaults. Raitaru/Azbel with ME rig: set structure_me_bonus e.g. 0.02 (T1 rig hisec) / 0.024 (T2 rig).
_relist_comment: My Orders: if the market will sell everything ahead of you plus your order within this many days anyway, the advice is to wait instead of paying the relist fee
_pi_comment: Customs office tax rate of your PI planets (export; import is half of it). Can also be changed in the PI tab.
_liquidity_comment: Items whose invented BPC output takes longer than this many days of the regional daily volume to sell are flagged as illiquid
